messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — inference-serving error spike detected in us-east-1 for rw-instruct-13b. Error rate >10% over 5m. War room created: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/123456789 (passcode: 6821). Paging @amanda @sanjay. Please ack and join.
amanda: @incident-bot ack — I'm oncall and joining war room now. I'll own initial triage and customer comms draft. @laura are you available to prep outbound notices?
sanjay: joining war room. I can take mitigation owner if needed. First quick check: tailing logs and checking model runtime memory.
amanda: assigning mitigation owner -> @sanjay. I'll handle statuspage draft and coordinate support pings.
laura: available — will start assembling list of impacted customers and prepare email templates. Recommend top-5 phone + next-20 email.
ops-bot: Automated action: scaled inference-service us-east-1 down + enabled fallback routing to cpu-backend in us-east-1a/us-east-1b. Traffic diversion in progress.
sanjay: running checks:
```
# tail recent errors
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference --tail=200 | grep -i "ERROR\|timeout"
# check pod OOMs
kubectl -n inference describe pod -l app=inference | egrep "OOM|Killed|Back-off"
```
sanjay: initial finding — a subset of GPU nodes showing repeated CUDA OOMs around model kv-cache growth during long-context requests. Trying a quick rollback to a known-good revision and reducing batch size briefly.
jamal: heads up — product flagged a spike in customer-reported errors on managed endpoints. If we need to throttle, please notify PM + Support.
amanda: statuspage draft (please review): "We are investigating increased inference error rates affecting requests in us-east-1. Some requests may see 5xx or timeouts. Mitigation is in progress; we will provide updates every 15–30 minutes. Impacted customers may experience degraded response reliability."
laura: looks good. I'll prep targeted emails using that copy + action items. Will add a short FAQ about retry/backoff guidance.
amanda: posting statuspage short update now (internal review ok) — will ping once live.
ops-bot: statuspage post queued to draft; waiting for human publish by amanda.
amanda: published initial statuspage update. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-17-inference-us-east. @laura please review customer list and start outreach.
oncall-sre: ack — I will accept the oncall handoff at 03:00 UTC. Please add handoff notes to the runbook and include current mitigations.
amanda: noted — oncall handoff scheduled. Handoff checklist: current mitigation (fallback routing + reduced batch), owner (sanjay), statuspage (published), customer outreach (laura), postmortem owner (jamal). Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/inference/incident-runbook
sanjay: executing mitigation: rolling back to rw-instruct-13b@rev-20260220 on 30% of traffic first. Command:
```
inferctl deploy model --name rw-instruct-13b --version rev-20260220 --region us-east-1 --traffic 30
```
sanjay: also applying temporary config to reduce batch size and disable kv-cache for affected nodes:
```
curl -s -X POST https://ops-api.internal/config -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"batch_size":8,"kv_cache_enabled":false}'
```
ops-bot: Config change applied to inference-service/us-east-1 (rollout: 2/3 nodes). Monitoring for error reduction.
amanda: customer comm plan: laura will do targeted outbound to top customers; support channel will use templated replies; we will issue a broader status update once mitigation shows improvement. Next internal update in 15 minutes here. If error rate <2% for 10m, we will relax fallback.
jamal: postmortem owner noted. I'll collect timeline and high-level impact metrics during the incident. Please add any customer escalations to the incident thread.
amanda: paging confirmation: @oncall-sre please ack when you join war room at 03:00 UTC. If anyone needs to escalate to execs, ping #exec-ops.
oncall-sre: ack — will join and take over at handoff time. I'll include routing to alternate region if required.
amanda: thanks all. Short updates here every 15 mins or on-call war room if traffic shifts. :thumbsup:
